BiblicalUsage: Gûwb means to dig, to till the ground. It stands in 2 Kings 25:12, where the poor of the land are left as husbandmen and vinedressers.
TheologicalSignificance: This one, gûwb, I take at face value: to dig.
RelatedEvents: Fall of Jerusalem and the Exile
